testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-001 Login with Valid Employee Credentials
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Happy flow: Employee logs in with valid credentials → Dashboard is displayed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Dashboard screen displayed with employee name and modules

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Happy flow: Employee enables biometric login and authenticates successfully → Dashboard is displayed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Dashboard screen displayed with employee name and modules

testcases.TestCaseDescription: UI validation: Login screen renders all expected elements (title, input fields, button, links)
testcases.ExpectedElements: Login title, Employee ID field, Password field, Login button, Forgot Password link, Sign Up link

testcases.TestCaseDescription: UI validation: Loading indicator appears and disappears appropriately during login
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: Loading indicator displays during authentication, then disappears on success/failure

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-010 Employee ID Field Required Validation
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Field validation: Empty Employee ID → inline error message displayed
Field validation: Empty Password → inline error message displayed
Field validation: Invalid Employee ID format → error message displayed
Field validation: Empty both fields → error messages displayed for both fields
testcases.ExpectedErrors: Employee ID is required, Password is required

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-020 Login with Invalid Employee ID
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Negative: Invalid Employee ID → error toast displayed, user remains on login screen
Negative: Correct Employee ID but wrong password → error toast displayed

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-022 Account Lock After Failed Attempts
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Negative: Multiple failed login attempts (5+) → account temporarily locked
testcases.ExpectedError: Account locked due to multiple failed attempts. Try again after 15 minutes.
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Login button disabled, wait timer displayed

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Negative: Inactive employee account → error message displayed
testcases.ExpectedError: This account is inactive. Contact your administrator.

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: User clicks 'Forgot Password' → password reset screen displayed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Password reset screen displayed with Employee ID field and verification options

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-031 Password Reset with Email Verification
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: Enter Employee ID → email verification sent → set new password

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-032 Password Reset with OTP Verification
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: Enter Employee ID → OTP sent to registered phone → set new password

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-033 Password Reset with Invalid OTP
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: Invalid OTP entered → error message displayed

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-034 Password Reset with Expired OTP
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: OTP expired (> 10 minutes) → request new OTP
testcases.ExpectedError: OTP expired. Request a new OTP.

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-035 Password Reset with Mismatched Passwords
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: New password and confirm password do not match → error displayed

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-036 Password Reset with Weak Password
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Password reset flow: New password too weak (no uppercase/special chars) → validation error
testcases.ExpectedError: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Edge case: User inactive for 30 minutes → session expires → user redirected to login
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Session expired message, redirected to login screen
testcases.ExpectedMessage: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Edge case: User logs in after app update → no issues with cached data

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-L-050 Biometric Login When Not Configured
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Edge case: Biometric login option shown but not configured on device → fallback to password
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: Biometric option disabled/hidden, password login available

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Edge case: Network disconnected during login attempt → error message and retry option
testcases.ExpectedError: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Edge case: Login credentials case sensitivity handling (Employee ID uppercase vs lowercase)
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Login successful if Employee ID is case-insensitive
